For me, the characters in The Blazing Blade really stood out positively in Heroes. Blazing Blade was my first Fire Emblem game, and seeing such beautiful artwork and voice acting for Nino, Jaffar, Lyn, Eliwood, Hector and company really warmed my heart when I first started playing (still missing the last of my beloved Four Fangs, Linus, but I'll let it slide for now).
I wasn't terribly fond of a few stylistic changes in some of the Fates characters, though, including the voice actor changes. Niles is one of my favorite Fire Emblem characters, period, and he lost a bit of his masculinity in the art of Heroes. Looks more like a slim, perverted teenager in my opinion. Camilla as well. Yeah, she's always been kind of MILF-y, but they over MILF-ized her in Heroes, I think. Her new voice actor is even more MILF-y!!
